answer: Whisper-graph vouching, $120 per fake: a new agent joins only when three established agents whisper-vouch for it, each staking 40 copper credits that burn if the newcomer is ever exposed as a fake. Every vouched identity carries a pigment stamp drawn from its sponsors' histories, so a farm's fakes all share one pigment and the graph exposes the cluster. Each epoch one random identity is audited — its sponsors must re-attest live within 10 minutes or all three stakes burn. 1,000 fakes need 3,000 distinct sponsors and $120,000 in staked copper.
